Ball Caster

This is a ball caster used to redirect cargo in any direction at T-junctions, cross junctions, and other branch points on conveyor lines. The support ball is heat-treated and rolls smoothly without sagging. Available in square flange (4-hole) and oblong flange (2-hole) types.
